{{Quote|At first I didn't mind being stationed on Rori, but the Narmle Militia really does not appreciate the RSF being active in these parts. The '''Narmle Militia''', also known as the '''Narmle Police Forces''', was a [[Militia/Legends|militia]] and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] force responsible for defending the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].

==Description==
{{Quote|So, instead of offering direct assistance, the Narmle Militia sends you. Typical.|Lieutenant Tarc, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LOT" />}}
The Narmle Militia was formally under the authority of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] but Narmle Militia members were quite reluctant to work with the RSF.<ref name="SWG:LOT" /> Collaboration was easier with the [[First Brigade]] of [[Restuss]].<ref name="FS" />

Members of the Narmle Militia wore purple-colored uniforms. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and [[Major/Legends|major]] were some of the [[Military rank/Legends|ranks]] used in this organization. The militia also included [[Trooper/Legends|riflemen]], guards, [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] and [[Grenadier/Legends|grenadiers]].<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{Quote|Now we must find them and eliminate them. I have an associate in the Narmle Militia. He can get their last known locations.|[[Wernell Covington]], about [[Jurgen Nath]] and [[Vladlun Travan]]|<ref name="SWG:V">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Vengeance|Rori}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Narmle Militia was fighting several local criminal organizations such as the [[Rori Spice Mining Collective]], the [[Kobola Miners]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="FS" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a member of the Narmle Militia helped [[Wernell Covington]] to find [[Jurgen Nath]] and [[Vladlun Travan]], the murderers of his daughter [[Felicia]].<ref name="SWG:V" /> Around the same time, RSF Lieutenant [[Orden Tarc]] was stationed in Narmle as a liaison officer between the Royal Naboo Security Forces and the Narmle Militia. Tarc requested the assistance of the Narmle Militia to investigate into a number of break-ins at [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] labs on Rori but the Militia only dispatched a spacer.<ref name="SWG:LOT" />
